concerns.text: T016 and T019 are marked as [ ] (incomplete) but are critical for User Story 1 (FR-001, FR-002). T016 (dynamic subset generation) and T019 (exclusion report) are prerequisites for T017/T018. Without these tasks being actionable (or marked as completed if the logic is assumed), the dataset preparation phase is blocked, preventing the implementation of FR-001 (download/cache) and FR-002 (extract 3D/2D) as defined in the spec.

All User Story 2 implementation tasks (T030-T034, T042-T044) are marked [ ] (incomplete). While this is expected for a 'tasked' stage, the tasks lack explicit traceability tags (e.g., [FR-004], [FR-005]) in their descriptions or headers, making it difficult to verify coverage against the mandatory FR-004 through FR-008 and SC-001, SC-005 requirements without inferring from file paths. Specifically, T032 (DFT reference) and T034 (metrics.csv) need explicit FR-011 and FR-012 tags to confirm coverage.

User Story 3 tasks (T039-T045) are marked [ ] (incomplete). T039 (attribution) and T041 (t-tests) are critical for FR-007, FR-008, and SC-002, SC-004. The tasks describe the implementation but lack explicit [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tags in the task line itself, relying on the description text. This increases the risk of coverage gaps if the description is misinterpreted. T040 and T045 (documentation) are essential for FR-011 (validation scope) but are not explicitly tagged to that requirement.

Tasks T130, T131, T132 are marked [ ] (incomplete) and reference 'Reviewer Response' concerns. While these address specific reviewer comments, they are not explicitly tagged to any FR/SC in the spec (e.g., FR-011 for scope limitations). The tasks should include tags like [FR-011] or [Spec Assumptions] to ensure they are recognized as covering the mandatory scope documentation requirements.

T116, T117, T118 are marked [ ] (incomplete). T117 (hygiene/hashes) is critical for Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and V (Versioning), but lacks a [Constitution] or [FR-030] tag. T118 (end-to-end verify) is critical for SC-003 (runtime) and SC-005 (reproducibility) but lacks explicit [SC-NNN] tags.
